troubleshooting.Location Not Found or Inaccurate:
There could be multiple reasons why the location is coming inaccurate. Please try the following -

Check Location Settings: Ensure GPS / Location is turned ON

Enable App Permissions: Go to your device Settings → Apps → Namma Yatri → Permissions → Location Make sure it's set to Allow all the time or While using the app.

Turn Location Off & On: Switch off GPS, wait a few seconds, then turn it back on.

Check for App & OS Updates: Update the Namma Yatri app and your phone's operating system to the latest version.

Restart Your Device: A restart helps refresh location services
troubleshooting.Unable to Login:
There could be multiple reasons why you are unable to login. Please try the following —

Check Internet Connection: Ensure you have a stable Wi-Fi or mobile data connection.

Clear Cache and Data: Go to your device settings, clear the app's cache and data, and try logging in again.

Check for App Updates: Make sure you are using the latest version of the app. Update it via the App Store or Google Play Store if needed.
troubleshooting.My App is Not Responding:
There could be multiple reasons why the app isn't responding. Please try the following —

Check Internet Connection: Ensure that you have a stable internet connection (Wi-Fi or mobile data).

Restart the App: Close the app completely and restart it.

Clear Cache: Go to your phone's settings, find the Namma Yatri app, and clear its cache.

Update the App: Check the app store for any available updates and install the latest version.

Reboot the Device: Restart your device to refresh all system processes.
